Termination.name: Termination
Termination.definition: Amount of principal plus interests at termination.

Accrued.name: Accrued
Accrued.definition: Specifies the accrued interest on the value of the principal trade, in the currency of the principal trade.

CompoundSimpleAccrualCalculation.name: Compound Simple Accrual Calculation
CompoundSimpleAccrualCalculation.definition: Specifies whether the interest calculation method is simple or compounding.

PaymentFrequency.name: Payment Frequency
PaymentFrequency.definition: Specifies when the accrued interest is paid.

InterestPaymentDelay.name: Interest Payment Delay
InterestPaymentDelay.definition: Number of days after the accrual payment is due.

TransactionAmountBreakdown.name: Transaction Amount Breakdown
TransactionAmountBreakdown.definition: Breakdown of transaction amount (required value for the exposure)  into market value lots based on the underlying trades.

ValueSought.name: Value Sought
ValueSought.definition: Value of collateral offered or sought.
